deferredTurns.promptSummary: Review EstaCoda's real command completion and task-result summary implementations. Delegate a repository research worker with file.read, terminal.run and process.logs access. The paths are already known: src/runtime/command-completion-checks.ts, src/utils/task-result-summary.ts and their corresponding .test.ts files. Read those files directly; no discovery search is needed. Have the worker execute both existing test files with vitest.node.config.ts. Keep the initial command observation wait short (around one second) while allowing the tests to finish; collect the final exit status without restarting the same test command. Return a substantial source-cited assessment and actual test results. Do not edit source or tests. Then synthesize the worker's findings, explicitly disclosing any missing coverage
